default.text: The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
Concentrate every minute on doing what's in front of you with precise and genuine seriousness.
First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.
Don't explain your philosophy. Embody it.
It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.
We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
Great acts are made up of small deeds.
Do the difficult things while they are easy and do the great things while they are small.
Nature does not hurry, yet everything is accomplished.
When walking, walk. When eating, eat.
Before enlightenment, chop wood, carry water. After enlightenment, chop wood, carry water.
In the beginner's mind there are many possibilities, but in the expert's there are few.
Flow with whatever may happen, and let your mind be free.
Muddy water is best cleared by leaving it alone.
You have power over your mind, not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.

empty.text: In the beginner's mind there are many possibilities, but in the expert's there are few.
The usefulness of a pot comes from its emptiness.
Empty your cup so that it may be filled.
A journey of a thousand miles begins beneath one's feet.

idle.text: Waste no more time arguing what a good man should be. Be one.
How long are you going to wait before you demand the best for yourself?
The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
While we wait for life, life passes.
What stands in the way becomes the way.
Don't explain your philosophy. Embody it.

overloaded.text: If you seek tranquillity, do less. Or, more accurately, do what's essential.
Ask yourself at every moment: is this necessary?
To attain knowledge, add things every day. To attain wisdom, remove things every day.
To be everywhere is to be nowhere.
Manifest plainness, embrace simplicity, reduce selfishness, have few desires.
Nature does not hurry, yet everything is accomplished.
It is not the man who has too little, but the man who craves more, who is poor.

cold.text: The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
A tree that fills a man's arms grows from a tender shoot.
Great acts are made up of small deeds.
Begin at once to live, and count each separate day as a separate life.
Every new beginning comes from some other beginning's end.
Fall seven times, stand up eight.
Do the difficult things while they are easy and do the great things while they are small.

roaring.text: When the work is done, retire. This is the way of heaven.
Knowing when to stop keeps you from danger.
Fill your bowl to the brim and it will spill.
He who knows that enough is enough will always have enough.
Sit quietly, doing nothing. Spring comes, and the grass grows by itself.
Be content with what you have; rejoice in the way things are.
Nature does not hurry, yet everything is accomplished.
